## About This Document

**Laserheart** is a science fiction framework built on the Daggerheart SRD. Its purpose is to let a table drop into any sci-fi setting — space opera, military sci-fi, cyberpunk, hard science — without relearning the game. If you know Daggerheart, you can play Laserheart in minutes.

This document is the framework reference. It contains:

- The core **terminology map** from Daggerheart to Laserheart
- Rules for **Origins**, **Factions**, and **Domains**
- The **Vessel** (ship) system
- The optional **Enhanced Play** module (Tech vs. Psionics)
- The optional **Resonance Track** for Psionic characters
- Three ready-to-use **Setting Profiles**

## What You Need to Play

Laserheart requires the **Daggerheart Core Set** or access to the **Daggerheart SRD 1.0**. This document does not reproduce the core rules — it adapts and extends them for science fiction play. All core mechanics (Action Rolls, Hope/Fear, Stress, Evasion, the card-based ability system) function exactly as written in Daggerheart.
